title: Estimating the Growing Stem Volume of Coniferous Plantations Based on Random Forest Using an Optimized Variable Selection Method
summary: Stepwise random-forest feature selection and random-forest regression estimated conifer-plantation stem volume from Sentinel-2 imagery and field observations. The selected model reduced relative RMSE by 10.6–16.4% versus comparison variable-selection methods in the Wangyedian study area; broader geographic transfer was not established.
